Professional Summary
Frontend Engineer focused on building component-driven, accessible web interfaces using modern frontend frameworks and styling systems. Experienced in designing and documenting reusable UI components, optimizing delivery pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship features with quality. React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Storybook, Confluence, Linux

- Documented component usage and design decisions in Confluence; established live Storybook demos for stakeholder review and reduced design-implementation iterations.

- Collaborated on TypeScript migrations and Linux-based CI builds to catch regressions earlier and streamline deployments.
